rationale: The source level is reset in the source domain and the destination synchronizer is held in reset whenever either domain reset is active, preventing an isolated receiver from decoding stale toggle state.

mutation.description: Reduced the pulse synchronizer to a toggle crossing with a reset coupling that holds the receiver down with the sender.

provenance.adaptation: Removed assertion infrastructure and retained the source-toggle, two-stage destination synchronizer, and coupled reset.
